theme: Barnaby, Milly, and Pipkin discover a hidden patch of evening glow-berries and work together to deliver tiny lantern baskets to woodland neighbors who need a soft light to guide them home.
title: The Little Glow-Berry Lanterns

theme: When a quiet morning shower keeps the friends indoors, Barnaby, Milly, and Pipkin turn hollow acorn caps, dried seed pods, and rhythmic raindrops into a cozy kitchen orchestra, discovering how sweet a gray day can sound together.
title: The Rainy Day Kitchen Orchestra
